posts.title: Software Engineering With LLMs
posts.description: LLMs and coding agents like Claude Code crank out code but have poor taste. They are irrepressibly-enthusiastic junior savants. Irrepressibly enthusiastic junior savants are super useful! However, when used carelessly you’re at the mercy of the model. posts.title: LLMs Are Microtransactions For Software Engineering
posts.description: Sometimes I finish a session in Claude Code and run the /cost command. “It cost $2.37 to fix that bug,” etc etc. My own time is involved, of course, but seeing the cost in tokens and vendor spend is helping me think about building and tending software in a way I haven’t before.
